toLang.prompt: The queens do not follow the archers at dawn.
toLang.explanation: O S V order. bemki-bemki = PL~archer; teti-teti = PL~queen; norema = at.dawn; tabe-sa = follow-NEG.

grammar: Word order: object, subject, verb. With one participant: subject, verb.
Plural: say the noun twice (teti → teti-teti).
